articles.summary: Hims & Hers named Kultar Garcha, MD, as Chief Medical Officer of the UK and EMEA. Hear from Dr. Garcha on his path into medicine, why he joined Hims & Hers, and what's ahead for clinical care across the region.
articles.title: Redefining What Quality Care Means with Kultar Garcha, MD, Chief Medical Officer of the UK & EMEA

articles.summary: Hims named Matt Vickers, FRACGP, MBBS, BMedSci, AICGG, as Chief Medical Officer of Hims Australia. Hear from Dr. Vickers on his path into digital health, what rural Australians are up against, and what he’s focused on for this year and beyond.
articles.title: Rural Access and Digital Health with Matt Vickers, Chief Medical Officer of Hims Australia
